what: The three route-level boundaries, rendered and measured against a production build.

target.note: never next dev: theme init and error boundaries both behave differently there

reproducibility.not-found.tsx: reproducible by anyone: any unmatched URL, and npm run check:ui audits it as /_not-found on every run
reproducibility.error.tsx: needed a temporary throwing route (src/app/probe-error/page.tsx, force-dynamic, throws in render). Created, measured, deleted. Re-measuring means recreating it.
reproducibility.global-error.tsx: needed a temporary client component that throws during render, mounted in the ROOT layout beside OfflineBanner, keyed on ?probeGlobalError=1. A throw from a nested layout does NOT reach this boundary; only the root layout does. Created, measured, deleted, and src/app/layout.tsx diffed back to identical.

theme.method: CDP Page.startScreencast, everyNthFrame 1, png, capped at the 390x844 viewport, deviceScaleFactor 1. Same technique as tests/e2e/theme-flash.spec.ts. The tab is painted magenta (#ff00ff) before navigating, so a frame still showing the old document cannot be counted as a light flash. Every frame decoded and classified by the colour covering most of it.
theme.grid: 3 boundaries x stored {light, dark}, device preference opposite in every case

negativeControl.what: an init script strips the .lt class 250ms after load, a deliberate late flash
negativeControl.result: WRONG=1 on each of the 3 boundaries. The instrument is not blind.

theme.themeColorMeta: all 3 theme-color metas carry the resolved colour on all 3 boundaries: #0b1020 for stored dark, #edf0f7 for stored light, matching the value / on the same device

defectFoundAndFixed.what: When the root layout throws on the client React does not hydrate this tree, it renders it fresh into the existing document, and rendering <html> with no className WIPED the lt class THEME_INIT_SCRIPT had already applied. Measured directly: stored=light device=dark gave `html class="" style=null` on global-error against `html class="lt" style="color-scheme: light"` on /. One theme-color meta also stayed at its static JSX value.
defectFoundAndFixed.fix: the scope class and colorScheme are now React props on <html>, computed in a useState lazy initialiser from the stored choice, so they land on the first commit rather than a repaint later; the metas are written from the same state; and ThemeProvider is mounted in the body so its head MutationObserver rewrites any meta React re-inserts, exactly as it does on every other route

pseudoLocale.result: every string on all 3 boundaries renders transformed, including the footer disclaimer. scrollWidth still 390 at 390 under the ~40 percent expansion, no clipping.
pseudoLocale.note: the global boundary's reload label fills {name} from t("app.name"), so it renders as one transformed string carrying another, nested rather than adjacent. src/lib/i18n/pseudo.ts reserves adjacent bracket pairs for the concatenation bug it hunts, so this is the catalogue working.

checkUi.notAudited: /_global-error, which check:ui skips by design as a shell no navigation reaches. It was measured by hand instead, above.
